title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
snippet: OpenAI said this model, which is still in development, reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems.

title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
snippet: After its own AI usage wake-up call, Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console, a product that tracks individual and team employee AI spending.
